User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the system.

uid.description: The unique ID of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

role.description: The role of the user, e.g., 'admin' or 'shop'.

createdAt.description: The date and time the user was created.

phoneNumber.description: The phone number of the user.

upiId.description: The UPI ID of the admin user for receiving payments.

imageUrl.description: URL for the user's profile image.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a product in the inventory.

stock.description: The current stock level of the product.

position.description: The order of the product in the list.

rate.description: The price or rate of the product.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Represents an order placed by a shop.

shopId.description: The UID of the shop that placed the order.

shopEmail.description: The email of the shop that placed the order.

items.description: An array of items included in the order.

status.description: The current status of the order.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the order was placed.

Laborer.title: Laborer
Laborer.description: Represents a laborer available for work.

name.description: The full name of the laborer.

trade.description: The trade or skill of the laborer (e.g., 'Electrician', 'Plumber').

Attendance.title: Attendance
Attendance.description: Represents a daily attendance record for a laborer.

laborerId.description: The ID of the laborer this record belongs to.

date.description: The specific date of this attendance record (YYYY-MM-DD).

status.description: The attendance status for the day.

checkIn.description: The time the laborer checked in.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile information, including their role.

/products/{productId}.description: Stores all available products for the distribution system.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Stores all orders placed by shops.

/attendance/{attendanceId}.description: Stores daily attendance records for all laborers.
